about: The alert rules of grafana/alerts/agent-alerts.yaml, for python -m obs alerts (windows counted in closed runs).

rules.title: A write timed out and nobody checked whether it happened
rules.first_step: Run `python -m obs find duplicate_write` (or the TraceQL query `duplicate write` in grafana/traceql.md), then ask the payment system for each operation ID before anyone sends the change again.

rules.title: Replies to customers failed
rules.first_step: Open the runs with `larkfield.reply.status = failed`; check that each ticket went to a person, not to resolved.

rules.title: Runs stopped by a loop limit
rules.first_step: Open three stopped runs (`python -m obs find loop`): which model, which step repeats? Compare with the last release.

rules.title: Cost per resolved ticket over budget
rules.first_step: Split the cost by model and slice (`python -m obs cost --by model`, the Cost panels): which change raised it? The budget (US$0.002 per resolved ticket) is an assumption: Omar's.

rules.title: Too many tickets handed to a person
rules.first_step: Group the handed-over runs by model and stop reason (`python -m obs runs --outcome handed_to_person`).
